note: RadioGroup is a radiogroup with an optional label, its radios share a name (generated when not given) so arrow keys move between them, and it keeps the typed values of its options: false, 0 and '' stay selectable and onChange receives the option's own value rather than a string. Button-variant radios are visually hidden instead of display:none, so they stay focusable and show a focus ring, and the default radio's focus outline is valid CSS and shown on :focus-visible
